Why are American work hours going up?

Because job security is going down.

People are more willing to work longer hours because they don't want to be seen as slackers. They want to be seen as the hard workers, as the efficient ones. More often than not, they're just trying to make the hours pass quicker.

These people are not being paid by the hour, more often than not. This means the company ends up paying less per hour for more work.
Follow up: remember the good old days when people were convinced that more efficient means of production would lead to shorter work days? What happened to that?

They just want people to work the same hours, doing a more efficient job, with no increase in pay, but an increase in productivity and out put for the company.
